Venomous_Centipede_Graspers.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths, the Venomous_Centipede_Graspers are a grotesque amalgamation of writhing, agile tentacles that dart and grip with preternatural speed, their toxic excretions capable of incapacitating prey within moments, while their elongated reach and natural climbing abilities make them a formidable and elusive predator in the twisted ecosystems of the game world.

Stinging_Wasp_Tendrils.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths of the corrupted forest, the Stinging Wasp Tendrils are a nightmarish blend of insect and parasite, their swift, venomous appendages capable of striking with deadly precision and enveloping foes in a toxic cloud, marking them for certain doom.

Silk_Spinning_Spider_Tendrils.description: These slender, silk-coated tendrils are the spider's crowning achievement, blending delicate grace with deadly precision, allowing the creature to traverse vertical surfaces with ease while enhancing its agility and stealth.

Heavy_Beetle_Pincer_Tentacles.description: The Heavy Beetle Pincer Tentacles are thick, armored appendages bristling with powerful, razor-sharp pincers that not only grant the wielder immense strength and natural armor but also enable devastating skills like Sunder and Knockdown.

Luminescent_Firefly_Lasso_Tendrils.description: Glowing with an eerie, pulsating light, the luminescent firefly lasso tendrils are delicate yet formidable appendages that weave through the shadows, their magic-laden tips capable of ensnaring prey with a hypnotic allure and then tightening like steel cables to grapple and restrain.

Acid_Secreting_Ant_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the chitinous exoskeleton, these serpentine tentacles pulse with a sickly green hue, their tips dripping with a corrosive acid capable of dissolving flesh and bone, while their presence grants an innate resilience against the toxins they unleash.

Camouflaging_Stick_Insect_Tendrils.description: Bristling with slender, chitinous tendrils that can stretch and contort with uncanny agility, this component allows the wielder to merge seamlessly with the shadows of their environment, granting them the silent grace and predatory cunning of a stick insect hunter.

Subterranean_Mole_Cricket_Root_Tentacles.description: The Subterranean Mole Cricket Root Tentacles are gnarled, earth-coated appendages that wrap around prey with the strength of coiled iron, their powerful grips fortified by the cricket's underground tenacity, granting formidable grapple and knockback resistance.

Ghost_Mantis_Spectral_Tendrils.description: The spectral tendrils of the ghost mantis undulate like wisps of smoke, their semi-transparent forms granting them an otherworldly stealth that allows them to blend seamlessly with the shadows, while their ethereal nature grants them the ability to perceive the unseen and the unheard.

Moth_Feathered_Sensory_Tentacles.description: Gossamer tentacles, reminiscent of moth wings, flutter and twist with an otherworldly grace, enhancing the host's perception and charisma as they detect the faintest traces of magic and alert the host to nearby threats, while also serving to mesmerize and lure unsuspecting prey.
